endpoints.title: Calculate Score (Synchronous)
endpoints.summary: Reads the account ABC classification and returns a CustomScore (A=90, B=70, C=50). SSC V2 waits for the response and persists the field automatically — no write-back call needed.
setupSteps: In SSC V2, open System Settings → Extensibility Administration → Account Service.
Open the External Hooks Tab on the right side and create a new External Hooks
Provide a name like 'AccountAfterSave'
Set the event to "Post-Hook" and the type to Synchronous.
Add an action of type "Call External Service / Webhook".
Paste this endpoint's path (without the hostname) into API Path.
Select your previously created Communication System
Save and activate the external hook.
Ensure a custom field "CustomScore" exists on the Account (Extensibility → Account Service → Custom Fields).
Go to any account, change the ABC classification and see how your CustomScore field gets updated.

endpoints.title: Calculate Score (Asynchronous)
endpoints.summary: Responds 202 immediately so the user's save completes instantly, then calculates the score in the background and writes it back to the CRM via GET (ETag) + PATCH (If-Match). Includes a switchable processing delay to illustrate slow operations.
endpoints.responseNote: 202 Accepted with { accepted: true, message: "Processing in background" }
setupSteps: In SSC V2, open System Settings → Autoflow.
Create a new AutoFlow for the Account entity.
Set the event type to "Update Account"
Configure the condition to check if the current ABC Classification is not equal the previous ABC classification.
Add an Event Notification
Enter any event name, select your communication system, and copy only the path from above.
Save and activate the autoflow
Optional: If you connected the external hook above, deactivate it before you test.
Ensure a custom field "CustomScore" exists on the Account (Extensibility → Account Service → Custom Fields).
Open any account that has already an ABC classification and change it to a different value.
Switch via the website here betweeen the 10 and 0 seconds delay to demonstrate the asynchronosity

endpoints.title: Create Urgent Opportunity Task
endpoints.summary: When an opportunity's priority changes to Urgent, creates a follow-up task linked to the opportunity, assigned to its owner and due in 3 days. Uses beforeImage vs currentImage so it only fires on an actual change.
endpoints.responseNote: 202 Accepted with { accepted: true, message: "Processing in background" }
setupSteps: In SSC V2, open System Settings → Autoflow.
Create a new AutoFlow for the Opportunity entity.
Set the event type to "Update Opportunity"
Configure the condition to check if the current Priority is not equal the previous Priority.
Add an Event Notification
Enter any event name, select your communication system, and copy only the path from above.
Save and activate the autoflow
Open any opportunity, change its priority to urgent and refresh it.
You should see a new related task after a few milliseconds.

endpoints.title: External Alerts
endpoints.summary: SSC V2 calls this endpoint on demand while rendering the Agent Desktop to display external alert signals (risk flags, compliance warnings) relevant for the currently calling customer.
endpoints.responseNote: 200 OK with { count, alerts: [{ signalType, icon, color, groupText, message }] }
setupSteps: In SSC V2, open System Settings → Communication Configuration.
Add a new communication configuration, select your communication system, give it a name, scroll down to HTTP Data and search for 'GET Alert Messages'
Enter the above path in the newly added HTTP data entry
Save and activate.
Open the Agent Desktop feature, search for any contact, accept it and see the newly displayed alerts in the left side.

endpoints.title: Account Insights Chart
endpoints.summary: UI Extension data provider. SSC V2 calls this when rendering a custom chart widget in the Account Insights panel. Returns chart data.
endpoints.responseNote: 200 OK with { total, data: [{ name, y }] }
setupSteps: In SSC V2, open System Settings → Custom key metrics
Add a new custom key metric
Fill in the names, select pie chart, copy the path and select your communication system.
Save.
Open any account and check the Account Insights section with your new chart (maybe you need to go to the next 'page'.)
